mapper.select: SELECT crd03_person_id AS person_id , crd03_person_nm AS person_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END AS crd03_person_id , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS crd03_person_nm FROM crd01_card INNER JOIN crd03_trans ON crd03_card_id = crd01_card_id WHERE crd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crd03_fr_dt)::text, 'YYYY') <= TO_DATE(#{year}, 'YYYY') AND crd03_fr_dt IS NOT NULL AND (TO_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crd03_to_dt)::text, 'YYYY') >= TO_DATE(#{year}, 'YYYY') OR crd03_to_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END) t ORDER BY CASE WHEN crd03_person_nm = '공통' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, crd03_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT biz01_real_person_id AS person_id , biz01_real_person_nm AS person_name FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END AS biz01_real_person_id , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_real_person_nm FROM crd01_card INNER JOIN crd03_trans ON crd03_card_id = crd01_card_id WHERE crd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(crd03_fr_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') <= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') AND crd03_fr_dt IS NOT NULL AND (TO_DATE(crd03_to_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') >= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') OR crd03_to_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false'), crd03_person_id) t GROUP BY biz01_real_person_id, biz01_real_person_nm UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE biz01_real_person_id END AS biz01_real_person_id , CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_real_person_id) END AS biz01_real_person_nm FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_std_ym LIKE #{year}||'%' AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY biz01_real_person_id) t GROUP BY biz01_real_person_id, biz01_real_person_nm ORDER BY CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_nm = '공통' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, biz01_real_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

biz03_use_item_nm , COALESCE((SELECT SUM(biz01_provide_amt) FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = biz01_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN crd03_trans ON ( crd03_card_id = biz01_card_id AND biz01_provide_date BETWEEN crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt,'9999-12-31') ) LEFT JOIN act01_account_code ON act01_account_code_id = biz01_account_code_id INNER JOIN crd02_data ON THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END ELSE CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NOT NULL THEN biz01_real_person_id ELSE crd03_person_id END END ) = #{personId} AND act01_account_code_id = biz.biz03_account_code_id GROUP BY biz03_use_item_cd),0) AS biz03_use_item_sum FROM biz03_account_map biz RIGHT JOIN ( ) sys ON sys.sys09_code = biz.biz03_use_item_cd) t GROUP BY biz03_use_item_cd, biz03_use_item_nm UNION ALL SELECT '99' AS use_item_code , '기타' AS use_item_name , COALESCE((SELECT SUM(biz01_provide_amt) FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = biz01_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN crd03_trans ON ( crd03_card_id = biz01_card_id AND biz01_provide_date BETWEEN crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt,'9999-12-31') ) LEFT JOIN act01_account_code ON act01_account_code_id = biz01_account_code_id INNER JOIN crd02_data ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_std_ym = #{year}||'.'||#{month} AND ( CASE WHEN #{cardRealUserType} = '관리자' THEN CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END ELSE CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NOT NULL THEN biz01_real_person_id ELSE crd03_person_id END END ) = #{personId} AND (act01_account_code_id IS NULL OR act01_account_code_id NOT IN (SELECT biz03_account_code_id FROM biz03_account_map biz RIGHT JOIN ( ) sys ON sys.sys09_code = biz.biz03_use_item_cd WHERE biz03_account_code_id IS NOT NULL))),0) AS use_item_sum ORDER BY use_item_code

SELECT biz03_use_item_cd AS use_item_code , biz03_use_item_nm AS use_item_name , SUM(biz03_use_item_sum) AS use_item_sum FROM ( SELECT sys09_code AS biz03_use_item_cd , sys09_name AS biz03_use_item_nm , COALESCE((SELECT SUM(biz01_provide_amt) FROM biz01_promo LEFT JOIN act01_account_code ON act01_account_code_id = biz01_account_code_id INNER JOIN crd02_data ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(biz01_std_ym, 'YYYY.MM') + INTERVAL '0 day' = To_DATE(#{year}||'.'||#{month}, 'YYYY.MM') AND TO_DATE(biz01_std_ym, 'YYYY.MM') + INTERVAL '0 day' <= #{closeDate} AND act01_account_code_id = biz.biz03_account_code_id GROUP BY biz03_use_item_cd),0) AS biz03_use_item_sum FROM biz03_account_map biz RIGHT JOIN ( ) sys ON sys.sys09_code = biz.biz03_use_item_cd) t GROUP BY biz03_use_item_cd, biz03_use_item_nm UNION ALL SELECT '99' AS use_item_code , '기타' AS use_item_name , COALESCE((SELECT SUM(biz01_provide_amt) FROM biz01_promo LEFT JOIN act01_account_code ON act01_account_code_id = biz01_account_code_id INNER JOIN crd02_data ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(biz01_std_ym, 'YYYY.MM') + INTERVAL '0 day' = To_DATE(#{year}||'.'||#{month}, 'YYYY.MM') AND TO_DATE(biz01_std_ym, 'YYYY.MM') + INTERVAL '0 day' <= #{closeDate} AND (act01_account_code_id IS NULL OR act01_account_code_id NOT IN (SELECT biz03_account_code_id FROM biz03_account_map biz RIGHT JOIN ( ) sys ON sys.sys09_code = biz.biz03_use_item_cd WHERE biz03_account_code_id IS NOT NULL))),0) AS use_item_sum ORDER BY use_item_code
mapper.sql: SELECT biz01_emp_nm AS emp_name , SUM(biz01_jan_sum ) AS jan_sum , SUM(biz01_feb_sum ) AS feb_sum , SUM(biz01_mar_sum ) AS mar_sum , SUM(biz01_apr_sum ) AS apr_sum , SUM(biz01_may_sum ) AS may_sum , SUM(biz01_jun_sum ) AS jun_sum , SUM(biz01_jul_sum ) AS jul_sum , SUM(biz01_aug_sum ) AS aug_sum , SUM(biz01_sep_sum ) AS sep_sum , SUM(biz01_oct_sum ) AS oct_sum , SUM(biz01_nov_sum ) AS nov_sum , SUM(biz01_dec_sum ) AS dec_sum , SUM(biz01_total_sum) AS total_sum

SELECT biz01_emp_nm biz01_emp_nm , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '01' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_jan_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '02' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_feb_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '03' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_mar_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '04' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_apr_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '05' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_may_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '06' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_jun_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '07' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_jul_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '08' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_aug_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '09' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_sep_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '10' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_oct_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '11' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_nov_sum , CASE WHEN COALESCE(month,'00') = '12' THEN amt ELSE 0 END biz01_dec_sum , COALESCE(amt,0) biz01_total_sum
mapper.select:
FROM (
FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END AS crd03_person_id , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_emp_nm FROM crd01_card INNER JOIN crd03_trans ON crd03_card_id = crd01_card_id WHERE crd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crd03_fr_dt)::text, 'YYYY') <= TO_DATE(#{year}, 'YYYY') AND crd03_fr_dt IS NOT NULL AND (TO_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crd03_to_dt)::text, 'YYYY') >= TO_DATE(#{year}, 'YYYY') OR crd03_to_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT month , CASE WHEN manager_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE manager_id END AS manager_id , SUM(amt) amt FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR(biz01_std_ym,6,2) AS month , f_get_crdManagerId2(biz01_card_id, biz01_provide_date) AS manager_id , COALESCE(biz01_provide_amt,0) AS amt FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND SUBSTR(biz01_std_ym,1,4) = #{year} AND TO_DATE(biz01_std_ym||'.01','yyyy.mm.dd') <= #{closeDate} ) t GROUP BY month, manager_id ) biz ON manager_id = crd03_person_id ) t2 GROUP BY biz01_emp_nm ORDER BY CASE WHEN biz01_emp_nm = '공통' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , biz01_emp_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

WITH emp_list AS ( SELECT biz01_manager_id , biz01_emp_nm FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END AS biz01_manager_id , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END AS biz01_emp_nm FROM crd01_card INNER JOIN crd03_trans ON crd03_card_id = crd01_card_id WHERE crd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_DATE(crd03_fr_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') <= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') AND crd03_fr_dt IS NOT NULL AND (TO_DATE(crd03_to_dt::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') >= TO_DATE(#{closeDate}::text, 'YYYY-MM-dd') OR crd03_to_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE crd03_person_id END , CASE WHEN COALESCE(crd03_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(crd03_person_id) END UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE biz01_real_person_id END , CASE WHEN biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN '공통' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(biz01_real_person_id) END FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_std_ym LIKE #{year}||'%' AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY biz01_real_person_id ) t GROUP BY biz01_manager_id, biz01_emp_nm ) , biz_data AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(biz01_std_ym,6,2) AS month, CASE WHEN sys01_card_real_user_yn = 'true' THEN CASE WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN crd03_public_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id IS NOT NULL THEN biz01_real_person_id ELSE crd03_person_id END ELSE crd03_person_id END AS manager_id , COALESCE(biz01_provide_amt,0) AS amt FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = biz01_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN crd03_trans ON (crd03_card_id = biz01_card_id AND biz01_provide_date BETWEEN crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt,'9999-12-31')) WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND SUBSTR(biz01_std_ym,1,4) = #{year} AND TO_DATE(biz01_std_ym||'.01','yyyy.mm.dd') <= #{closeDate} )
FROM (
FROM (SELECT e.biz01_manager_id , e.biz01_emp_nm , b.month , COALESCE(b.amt, 0) AS amt FROM emp_list e LEFT JOIN biz_data b ON e.biz01_manager_id = b.manager_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.biz01_emp_nm = '공통' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , e.biz01_emp_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") t ) t2 GROUP BY biz01_emp_nm ORDER BY CASE WHEN biz01_emp_nm = '공통' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , biz01_emp_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
